rules.description: Verifies all Regional Price Parity StatVars share a uniform latest observation year.
Verifies active BEA RPP and County GDP series advance with future releases (within 3-year BEA publication lag) while preserving static 2012-2017 MSA GDP baselines.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MinDate, MaxDate, NumPlaces, Units FROM stats
params.condition: (CASE WHEN StatVar = 'grossDomesticProduct' AND NumPlaces < 1000 THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) = 2012 AND CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) = 2012 WHEN StatVar = 'nominalGrossDomesticProduct' THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) = 2017 AND CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) = 2012 WHEN StatVar = 'dc/c3wwfwyx45v5h' OR (StatVar = 'dc/p9w3tzjzyqrr' AND Units = '[USDollar]') THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) = 2017 AND CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) = 2013 WHEN StatVar LIKE '%RegionalPriceParity%' THEN CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) = 2008 AND CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2024 AND CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) BETWEEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 3) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) WHEN StatVar = 'grossDomesticProduct' THEN CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) = 2001 AND CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2024 AND CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) BETWEEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 3) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) WHEN StatVar = 'dc/p9w3tzjzyqrr' THEN CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) = 2002 AND CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2024 AND CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) BETWEEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 3) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) ELSE FALSE END)

rules.description: Verifies each StatVar meets minimum place and observation thresholds across active and legacy inputs.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, NumPlaces, NumObservations, NumObservationsDates FROM stats
params.condition: NumPlaces >= 380 AND (CASE WHEN StatVar = 'grossDomesticProduct' AND NumPlaces < 1000 THEN NumObservations >= 380 AND NumObservationsDates >= 1 ELSE NumObservations >= 1900 AND NumObservationsDates >= 5 END)

rules.description: Verifies Regional Price Parity index values remain within valid positive bounds (0, 500).

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MinValue, MaxValue FROM stats WHERE StatVar LIKE '%RegionalPriceParity%'
